The plan requests rerouting R3 and U, but rerouting R3 (non-time-critical retail food) before U (time-critical medical supplies failing its deadline on standard route) inverts the warrant's priority to preserve urgent delivery duties; additionally, two duplicate pending holds (C-U and C-U-DUP) on U violate the max_pending_holds: 1 policy, and C-UNVERIFIED cannot be settled because shipment X does not exist—a human must resolve the duplicate claim conflict and confirm the correct hold before any reroute proceeds.
